title: Giraffe wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='18' ry='12' fill='#F4A824'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='78' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#F4A824'/>
  <rect x='38' y='80' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#E8941A'/>
  <rect x='50' y='78' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#F4A824'/>
  <rect x='58' y='80' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#E8941A'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='28' y='91' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B6914'/>
  <rect x='38' y='91' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B6914'/>
  <rect x='50' y='91' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B6914'/>
  <rect x='58' y='91' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B6914'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d='M50 66 Q56 50 56 36 L64 36 Q64 52 60 66 Z' fill='#F4A824'/>
  <!-- Spots on neck -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='46' r='3' fill='#D4761A'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='56' r='3' fill='#D4761A'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#D4761A'/>
  <!-- Spots on body -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='68' r='3.5' fill='#D4761A'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='64' r='3' fill='#D4761A'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='76' r='3' fill='#D4761A'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#D4761A'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='72' r='2.5' fill='#D4761A'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='30' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#F4A824'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='34' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#F8C860'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='33' r='1' fill='#A06010'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='36' r='1' fill='#A06010'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='27' r='3.5' fill='#3D2005'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='26' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='20' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#F4A824' transform='rotate(-20 56 20)'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='20' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#E8941A' transform='rotate(-20 56 20)'/>
  <!-- Ossicones (horns) -->
  <line x1='62' y1='20' x2='60' y2='13' stroke='#F4A824' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='12' r='3' fill='#D4761A'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='19' x2='68' y2='12' stroke='#F4A824' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='11' r='3' fill='#D4761A'/>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='64,16 56,4 72,4' fill='#FF4B8B'/>
  <polygon points='64,16 56,4 64,4' fill='#FF7AAE'/>
  <!-- Hat stripes -->
  <line x1='59.5' y1='9' x2='68.5' y2='9' stroke='#FFE03D' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='61.5' y1='13' x2='66.5' y2='13' stroke='#FFE03D' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Pom pom -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='3' r='3' fill='#FFE03D'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <line x1='24' y1='70' x2='17' y2='64' stroke='#F4A824' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='63' r='3' fill='#D4761A'/>
</svg>
